query:
WITH active_bot AS (
            SELECT id
            FROM bots
            WHERE id = $2
              AND team_id = $3
              AND deleted_at IS NULL
        )
        SELECT $1::text AS "source_id!"
        FROM active_bot
        UNION
        SELECT $3::text
        FROM active_bot
        UNION
        SELECT c.id::text
        FROM active_bot
        JOIN comms_channels c
          ON c.channel_type = 'team'
         AND c.team_id = $3
        UNION
        SELECT cp.channel_id::text
        FROM active_bot
        JOIN comms_channel_participants cp
          ON cp.user_id = $1
         AND cp.left_at IS NULL
